goal: A run parked unlanded (a LandingParked stop record) is automatically re-driven (re-claim, re-rebase, re-run command/standing graders, re-attempt land) up to a fixed bound; a parked run whose cause has cleared lands, and one whose cause never clears is routed to the human-review queue with a reason naming its park cause and no further land attempts.

relevant: packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- the landing-park sites (standing-verify ~609/659, divergent-base ~635/685), _record_landing_park (~907), _reverify/_standing_verify/_ff_merge: the re-rebase + re-run graders + re-attempt-land path to re-drive
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/events.py -- LandingParked (park_kind, detail) is the durable stop record consumed here
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_orchestrate.py -- the loop where the bounded re-drive cycle runs and routes to the queue surface
constraints: Re-attempting a land MUST re-run the rebase + command/standing graders against the exact base it lands on (reuse the worker rebase/reverify/standing path); never re-land without re-verifying

Bound the land-retry: at most `bound` automatic land attempts; on the bound, route the run to the queue with a machine-readable reason carrying its park_kind, and make no (bound+1)th attempt (criteria #4, #13)
Re-drive runs under the existing per-run budget ceilings (D-C); a re-attempt that breaches a ceiling is a routed stop, not a free retry
Re-claim through sanctioned claim APIs; the harness still owns transitions; commit before reporting done
non_goals: Do not modify files under packages/*/tests/; do not weaken or delete assertions
Do not change the merge-flock, rebase, protected-paths, or standing-verify mechanics (owned by 00061/00064)
edge_cases: An unbounded land-retry loop is a defect -- the count of automatic land attempts must equal the configured bound for a never-clearing cause
A re-driver that re-lands without re-running graders against the exact base must fail the behavior test
